title: Render only the tail of a streaming Claude reply
notes:
Measured: 2k/8k/16k-char answers at 600 chars/s put the renderer at 39%/69%/100% CPU; layout 9.5% to 31.5%, about 60 layouts/s. Typing unaffected (23 ms median). Where: src/renderer/chat/chat-view.ts:216-225, whole live block through marked each frame. Fix (medium): render finished part once, re-render only the tail after the last paragraph break outside a code fence. Rerun: measure.mjs chat. From profiling card dca04e6f, docs/performance/history.md 2026-11-02.

Shipped in PR #188: a streaming Claude reply draws its settled part once and redraws only the tail after the last paragraph break outside a code fence. 16k reply: renderer 66% to 51% CPU, script 8% to 2.2%. Replies with a link definition, a fence inside a list item or quote, or an HTML comment/pre block are still drawn whole each frame. Remaining cost is layout of the conversation above the block.
